sanskrit_verse:
ṛṇiṣv apratikurvatsu pratyaye vā vivādite
pratibhūs tad ṛṇaṃ dadyād anupasthāpayaṃs tathā
transliteration:
ṛṇiṣv apratikurvatsu pratyaye vā vivādite
pratibhūs tad ṛṇaṃ dadyād anupasthāpayaṃs tathā
sph_interpretive_translation: When a debtor fails to fulfill their obligation or disputes the debt, the surety shall assume the liability and discharge it accordingly.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows through capacity to fulfill
Causation is established by voluntary assumption of liability
Restoration logic demands completion of disrupted flow
Consciousness alignment occurs when duty is honored without dispute
executable_legal_axioms: IF debtor.fails_to_perform = TRUE AND dispute.exists = FALSE THEN surety.liability = TRUE
IF surety.accepts_liability = TRUE THEN surety.obligation.amount = debt.amount
IF obligation.discharged = TRUE THEN case.status = CLOSED
IF dispute.arises = TRUE THEN mediation.triggered = TRUE ELSE enforcement.initiated = TRUE
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, the threshold for invoking surety liability arises upon verified failure of primary debtor performance and absence of valid counterclaim. The hierarchy places personal commitment above mere contractual form.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that agreement creates binding energy; anupūrvaśaḥ shows how default transfers duty; proportional responsibility aligns with capacity assumed; non-punitive reality enforces completion, not penalty.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate surety liability activation protocol upon verified non-performance
Engage integrity-realignment session between parties to reaffirm dharma of fulfillment
Deploy consciousness-based settlement facilitation until resolution manifests
Record karmic completion upon full discharge and update universal ledger accordingly
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands as executed Dharma—restored in alignment, non-punitive in essence, and adjudicated by awakened consciousness alone.
